description: Client-side Fabric Qol mod for MCC Island

releases.notes:
## 1.1.8 - GUI Scale Fixes

### New
- **Utils**: new option "Better Item Amounts" (on by default). In the menus where the item list can be shown (Infinibag, Island Exchange...) and in a few other menus (Fishing Supplies, where your equipped bait shows how many are left, Summary...), each item shows its real amount instead of the vanilla stack count, in the MCC font on a dark frame, shortened to 3 characters (1.5k, 12k, 0.1M, 2.5B...).
- **Fishing**: new option "Show Perk Levels" (on by default). In the Fishing Perks menu, each perk shows its level (and in the Fishing Supplies menu, the Hook, Magnet, Rod and Unstable Overclocks) in the bottom right corner, in the same style as the item amounts. Two styles: "Level Only" (default, normal size, only your level) or "Small Level/Max" (smaller text with the max level, like 12/40). Perks at level 0 are shown in red.
- **Fishing**: new option "Show Tides and Winds in the Navigator" (on by default). In the Fishing Islands menu, each island shows its active tide in the bottom right corner and its active winds in the bottom left corner.
- **Settings**: new "Discord" link, to join the MccInfo Discord server.
- **Wipe to Black**: new "Iris" transition. A black circle closes on the middle of the screen, like at the end of old cartoons, and opens again once you arrive.
- **Parkour**: new option "In Fishing Messages" under Show Improvements (on by default). When Fishing Messages is on in the settings, your split times and improvements go in its box instead of the chat. The box opens by itself if it was hidden or if you are not in a fishing instance.

### Changes
- **Mcc JEI**: the Cosmetic Preview always shows the normal version of a cosmetic (the one you can wear). Locking a token or a blueprint locks the normal version and highlights all three. Middle-Click on a cosmetic group opens it and locks the normal version. The cosmetics you are wearing (like your cloak) now show their full item and tooltip.
- **Updates**: the mod no longer installs new versions by itself (was only for beta-testers anyways). When a new version is needed, the update box gives you the download link, and you replace the jar yourself.
- **Updates**: when a new version comes out, a recent older version can keep all its features for a while. The update box still suggests the new version.
- **Fishing**: in the Fishing Perks menu, the upgrade arrow on the perks you can upgrade is now in the top right corner of the slot.

### Fixes
- **Utils**: at a small GUI Scale, the icons on the items (missing materials, not owned, maxed, best island, upgradable perks, fish checkmarks...) were too big and covered the slots next to them. They now get smaller with the slots.
- **Quest Lock**: Shift-Clicking quests very fast could still reroll a locked quest. After a reroll, the quest slot now waits for the new quest before taking another Shift-Click.
- **Mcc JEI**: 3-star weapons now show their evolved model, and the Cosmetic Preview shows the star count you hover instead of always the 0-star version.
- **Mcc JEI**: the Cosmetic Preview now gets smaller when there is not enough room, instead of losing its tint panel or disappearing.
- **MccInfo Chat**: pressing the Up Arrow in the chat moved the focus to the MCCINFO button, so you could not edit the old message without clicking the text box. It now only brings back your last message.
- **Updates**: after pressing Later, the update box came back each time you changed server (lobby to a game...). It now stays closed until you leave MCC Island.

## 1.1.7 - Cosmetic Preview, Parkour Splits & Quest Lock

### New
- **Fishing**: new option "Show Checkmarks in the Fish Collection" (on by default) to show or hide the checkmark on the fish you caught in every weight.
- **Fishing**: in the Fishing Perks menu, perks you have everything to upgrade now show an upgrade icon in their bottom left corner. New option "Show Upgradable Perks" (on by default) to show or hide it.
- **Fishing**: the best island icon now also shows in the Fishing Islands menu.
- **Utils**: new options "Show Cosmetics Not Owned", "Show Missing Materials" and "Show Maxed Donations" (all on by default). Cosmetics you don't own yet show an icon in their top right corner, and items you are missing materials to craft show an icon in their bottom left corner.
- **Utils**: cosmetics you donated the maximum of now show an icon in their top right corner, in every menu.
- **Utils**: new option "Show Locked Style Perks" (on by default). In the Style Perks menu, perks that need a higher Style Level to upgrade show a lock in their bottom left corner.
- **Utils**: new Exchange section with the option "Show Lowest Prices" (on by default, needs a valid Api Key). In the Island Exchange, the listings with the lowest price for their item and amount show an icon in their top right corner.
- **Utils**: new option "Settings Info" (on by default, at the top of the Utils page). It opens a box on the right of the MccInfo menu that tells you more about the setting you hover or click, with text, links and pictures. Click a picture to see it in big.
- **Exchange**: new option "Tax Calculator" (on by default). When you enter the price of a listing, a box under it shows the coins you really receive after the 3% tax. Type the amount you want to receive in it (k, m and b work) and the listing price is filled in for you.
- **Utils**: new option "Show Completed Collections" (on by default). In the Cosmetic Collection menu, the collections where you unlocked every cosmetic show an icon in the top right corner: a special one when you also have every Full Chroma, another one when Full Chromas are still missing.
- **Cosmetic Preview**: new preview of your player on the left side of the inventory and of the menus with the Mcc JEI (option "Cosmetic Preview" in Utils, on by default, and its own "Cosmetic Preview" switch next to the Items switch). It keeps working when you hide the item list.
- **Cosmetic Preview**: hover a cosmetic in the item list, the favorites or your inventory to see your player wearing it (hats, accessories, back cosmetics, weapon skins and rods). Your player only shows up while you hover or lock a cosmetic, and the favorites go around it instead of being covered.
- **Cosmetic Preview**: click and drag your player to turn it all the way around or tilt it.
- **Cosmetic Preview**: Middle Click a cosmetic in the Mcc JEI, your inventory or a menu to lock it on your player, do it again to unlock it. Locked cosmetics get a highlighted background, and cosmetics show a "Middle-Click to Lock on Cosmetic Preview" line at the bottom of their tooltip. The "Lock Cosmetic on Cosmetic Preview" key can be changed in Keybinds.
- **Cosmetic Preview**: under your player, a slot shows each cosmetic it wears. Click one to select it, Middle Click one to unlock it.
- **Cosmetic Preview**: for hats, accessories and back cosmetics, a color panel lets you try a tint on the selected cosmetic (the last one you locked or clicked) (arrows to see more colors, click the color again to remove the tint). Weapon skins that use chromas show the Chroma Sets in the same panel instead, to try each chroma on your weapon.
- **Parkour**: new Parkour page in the MccInfo menu, with everything about Parkour Warrior.

...

## 1.1.6 - Fish Collection, Badge Tracker & Wheel Editor

### New
- Check InGame Patchnote!

### Changes
- **Best Island**: every augment is now taken into account (Elusive Ultralure, Elusive Soda, Pearl/Spirit/Treasure Ultralures...), your bait and line stop counting once they are used up, and locked islands are remembered.
- **Mcc JEI**: the search now accepts several words, and an item must contain all of them (for example "cloak epic" shows the Epic cloaks). Put words in quotes to search an exact phrase, like "fishing rod". Pressing Enter in the search bar now leaves it.
- **Recipe Mode**: cosmetics are now highlighted when one of their variants (token, blueprint or star level) has a recipe, and clicking a weapon skin shows the recipes of all its variants.
- **Mod badges**: your mod badge can no longer be hidden, every MccInfo player now shows it. The "Show Mod Badges" option only hides the badges in your own Tab list.
- **Keybinds**: MccInfo keys can now use key combinations like Ctrl + Y (with Ctrl, Shift and/or Alt). Keys without a combination still work while you hold Ctrl, Shift or Alt (for example while sprinting). In Keybinds Layout, only the exact same combination counts as a conflict, and debug keys are shown as F3 + key.
- **Recipes**: vendors and loot from an event that ended (like the Halloween 2026 Boogeyman Bazaar, Carnival Master, Carnival Shop and Raffles) now say "No longer available" instead of showing their NPC and the path to it.
- **Fish Collection**: the island and crab pot icons are now always shown, you no longer need to open the island navigator first.

### Fixes
- **Mcc JEI**: cosmetics with bonus trophies now show "Bonus Trophies:" with the bonus icon before the number, like in game.
- **Mcc JEI**: item groups (variants) and recipes were missing for everyone; they are back!!!
- **Emotes**: flat particle effects (like ground shockwaves) now lie flat instead of always facing the camera, and an effect played on top of another one is no longer hidden behind it.
- **Emotes**: when an emote that does not loop ends, your player no longer flickers for a frame before going back to normal.
- **Emotes**: once an emote that does not loop is over, its preview in the wheel now only shows your player instead of the model with all its props.
- **Emotes**: when an emote ends by itself, its sounds and particles now finish playing instead of being cut. They are still cut if you stop the emote early.
- **Mcc JEI**: the 4 Pumpkin Crossbow tokens of the Halloween Cosmetic Crate 2026 preview now show their real star level (0 to 3 stars) instead of all showing 0 stars.

## 1.1.5 - MccInfo Chat Fix & Badges

### New
- **Mcc JEI**: new Utils option. Turn it off to hide the item list, its search bar, the Switch Items toggle and Recipe Mode in inventories.
- **Show My Mod Badge**: new Utils option. Turn it off and other MccInfo players no longer see the mod icon next to your name in the Tab list; you no longer see theirs either.
- **See Others' Mod Badges**: new Utils option. Turn it off to hide the mod icon of other players in your Tab list.
- **Api Key page**: new page at the bottom of the menu, to save your own MCC Island API key for upcoming features (with a button to get one on the Noxcrew Gateway). It is kept only on your computer. (useless for the moment)

### Changes
- **MccInfo Chat names**: ranks, crowns, factions and MCC+ of the players now come from the MCC Island API instead of the Tab list, so nobody can fake them. No Api Key needed: everyone gets the styled names.
- **Tab badges**: the mod icons next to the names in the Tab list have a new texture, and they are now sent by the MccInfo server, so they can be updated without a new version of the mod.
- **Vendor NPCs in recipes**: the NPC next to a vendor now shows its name in gold in a box above it, and the area where to find it in a box below it (the < 1/x > arrows are under the area).

### Fixes
- **Compact Fishing Messages**: Triggered and You earned lines that arrived before their catch, or late because of lag, were sometimes left as separate lines; they are now added to the right catch line. (found by humiebees)
- **Shared items in the MccInfo chat**: they are now easy to hover, the whole icon shows the tooltip instead of a few pixels on its left.
- **Centered text**: text in the item list and recipe boxes (Previous, Next, < 1/x >...) and the unread count next to the MCCINFO and MOD chat buttons are now centered.

## 1.1.4 - Emotes Update

### Changes
- **Shared emote music**: when several players play the same emote next to each other, only the first one's music plays; the others fade back in, in time, once they move apart. If you arrive while an emote is playing, its music now starts at the right moment instead of from the beginning.
- **Smoother emotes**: the body now moves smoothly into the emote pose (the animation starts a few tenths of a second later) and smoothly back to normal when it stops, instead of snapping.
- **First person**: your own emote no longer shows its 3D models, mirage or air bands in front of your camera; particles and shockwaves are still shown.

### Fixes
- **Emote sound range**: stereo music could be heard at full volume from anywhere on the map; emote sounds are now only heard near the player playing them.
- **Emote sound direction**: music and sounds now come from the direction of the player playing the emote, instead of always sounding centered. While you play an emote, its music stays centered for you and for everyone playing the same emote with you.
- **Voice chat volumes**: changing the volume of a player, or of all other players, now actually changes what you hear.

## 1.1.3 - Vendors Update

### New
- **More vendors**: Frank, Big Cheese and most of the hidden vendors are now in the recipe viewer.
- **Filter by Rarity**: the filter button in vendor menus now works. Click it to go to the next rarity (right-click for the previous one).
- **Several NPCs per vendor**: use the < and > arrows under the NPC to switch between them.
- **Event Loot tab**: the Minor, Major and Mega Halloween Raffles, with their rewards, chances and the path to their NPC.
- **Emotes** *(coming soon)*: emotes in the widget wheel with a live preview of your skin. They can animate your body, add effects, music and particles around you, and other mod users see them too. Emote sounds can be turned off in the Widgets settings.

### Changes
- **Cosmetic tooltips** now show their bonus line and the Arcane Bonus like on MCC Island.
- **Menus** now follow your GUI Scale (GUI Scale 3 keeps the previous size).

First public version of MccInfo for Minecraft 26.2.

### New
- MccInfo is now public: the source code is on GitHub.
